title: Sound Controller: Tweaked
description: A fork of BVengo's Sound Controller, a mod that provides complete control over the volume of every sound in the game.
body:
---
## This mod is a fork.
This project originates from **BVengo**'s [**Sound Controller**](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-controller).

Their mod is already amazing! I've been a fan for a couple years now; if you like this fork, I'd ask that you consider supporting them on their [**Ko-Fi**](https://ko-fi.com/bvengo).

---

# What is Sound Controller?
**Sound Controller** offers a neat and convenient interface to search and adjust the volume of individual sounds.

This can be especially useful in cases where you want to adjust sounds without adjusting an entire sound category, such as when a certain entity (like endermen or villagers) that are too loud.

![Individual Sounds screen.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ad5fd8f169f97deb26d02ba15823da1e19f6f7f_0.webp)

# Why Use This Fork?
## 1) Neoforge
Though this wasn't my only reason for forking the mod, I'm sure this will be the main appeal for this fork, as the original mod wasn't written for Neoforge.
## 2) Tweaks
This fork serves as 'my take' on the mod; some of my tweaks so far include:
- **Categorized Sounds**
> The sound entries in the **Individual Sounds** screen are now grouped in collapsable categories for easier readability.
- **Filter Sound Categories**
> A new button allows you to filter out specific sound categories (namespace-insensitive) to show only the ones you're using.
- **New Buttons**
> This was a personal aesthetic choice; the original mod's buttons were done very well.
